about_the_game:
Compact Plasma Gears is a retro shoot'em up inspired by the NES-era classics. Pick a character to fight through ten levels, beat equal number of bosses and a significantly higher quantity of regular enemies.

The Preamble

An archaeological discovery in an independent mining system piques the interest of special services of Five Galaxies. Space Federation of the Second Galaxy rushes in to secure the finding and sends the Third External fleet under the ever unscrupulous command of Admiral Tai'nor Farth - though it seems local pirates also caught up the smell of profit, and if they did - so did everyone else.

What to expect from the game?

  • Pick up weapons to your liking (and try to keep them if you can avoid those space rocks)

  • Use score acquisition to fuel up your superweapon

  • Select a character to play as - the grumpy yet reliable chainsmoker Cap, or the volatile femme fatale Lady

  • Execute a potentially legal mission on behalf of Space Federation's Third External Fleet

  • Fight through space, mining facilities, space elevator, futuristic cityscape, and, of course, sewers

content_descriptors.notes: While the game overall presents minimal violence or horror elements, it contains scenes of combat with biomechanical entities and organic monsters, and destruction of piloted spacecraft implies potential death of pilots or crews. A character smoking pipe is a key character, a character hanging out with a glass of wine is also present.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD CPU at 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Embark on a retro-shoot-'em-up task to fight space pirates, industrial equipment, archeotech and, probably, space gods. Engage enemies in increasingly cruel levels, fight vile bosses, uncover secrets and pursue the call of ancient technologies.
